properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 8 at 3:01PM CDT by NWS Jackson MS
properties.description:
At 301 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Terry, or near Byram, moving west at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

This strong thunderstorm will be near...
Dry Grove around 305 PM CDT.
Raymond around 310 PM CDT.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 8 at 2:59PM CDT by NWS Jackson MS
properties.description:
At 258 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Branch, or 8 miles northwest of Morton, moving west at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

This strong thunderstorm will be near...
Leesburg and Pisgah around 305 PM CDT.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 8 at 2:55PM CDT until September 8 at 3:45PM CDT by NWS Jackson MS
properties.description:
SVRJAN

The National Weather Service in Jackson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northwestern Chicot County in southeastern Arkansas...

* Until 345 PM CDT.

* At 255 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Dermott,
moving southwest at 5 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Dermott around 300 PM CDT.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 8 at 2:39PM CDT by NWS Jackson MS
properties.description:
At 239 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles northwest of Shaw, or 9 miles southwest of Cleveland, moving
east at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

This strong thunderstorm will be near...
Cleveland, Shaw, Boyle, and Pace around 245 PM CDT.
Renova around 255 PM CDT.
Merigold around 330 PM CDT.

Other locations impacted by this storm include Halley.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 8 at 12:24PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
At 1221 PM PDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 16
miles south of Santa Rosa Island, moving north at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Frequent lightning and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Dangerous cloud-to-ground lightning and minor flooding.

Locations impacted include...
Santa Cruz Island...
Santa Rosa Island...
San Miguel Island...
Prisoners Harbor...
Central Valley...
and Anacapa Island.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.
properties.area: San Miguel and Santa Rosa Islands; Santa Cruz and Anacapa Islands

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued September 8 at 2:56PM EDT until September 8 at 4:30PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Pinellas County in west central Florida...

* WHEN...Until 430 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 256 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Up to 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Largo, Pinellas Park, Indian Rocks Beach, Ridgecrest, Harbor
Bluffs, Belleair, Belleair Bluffs, Belleair Beach, Belleair Shore
and Walsingham Park.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued September 8 at 1:50PM CDT until September 8 at 4:45PM CDT by NWS Huntsville AL
properties.description:
FFWHUN

The National Weather Service in Huntsville has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
North Central Lauderdale County in northwestern Alabama...

* Until 445 PM CDT.

* At 150 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain along the Alabama Tennessee
border in Northern Lauderdale County. Between 1.5 and 2.5 inches of
rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 3 to 4 inches in 1
hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Threet.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 8 at 11:01AM CDT until September 9 at 8:20PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Hardin,
Jasper, Orange and Jefferson Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...Until Wednesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 AM CDT Tuesday the stage was 26.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:45 AM CDT Tuesday was 27.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 19.4 feet Sunday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 26.7
feet on 04/24/1977.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 1215 PM CDT.
